acceptance.assertion: T057 is verified and binds PR #482 base, reviewed head, squash merge tree, diff, tests and post-merge review receipt.
Fresh status proves the current integrity-valid runtime contains merge d77ccc7, and the two reviewed files are unchanged between that merge and the deployed runtime head.
The existing deployment is observed as foreign independently authorized work; T059 performs no deployment and does not relabel, supersede or claim its authority or receipts.
Immediately before the first live effect, a fresh break-glass approval is bound to the exact runtime release, tunnel unit, controlled proof method, bounded expected restart and rollback plan.

Before every effect, read runtime identity, tasks, leases, worktrees, watchdog timers and services, connector snapshot, poll evidence and foreign work; unknown, drifted or conflicting state blocks execution.

A reversible non-secret proof produces repeated stale-poll evidence, observes the unchanged threshold and at most the existing bounded restart path, then restores the proof input without leaving a loop.
Unavailable, missing and timestamp-invalid metric evidence alone remains indeterminate and does not by itself authorize restart; concrete local failures retain their original unhealthy reasons.
After proof and restoration, both watchdog timers are active and waiting with future elapses, target services are healthy, restart counts remain bounded and no persistent failure loop exists.
Connector snapshot and poll freshness are current and matched, tool inventory remains exact, and at least one live Grabowski tool call succeeds after the proof.
Before the first effect, a tested rollback restores only the controlled proof input and affected service state; it does not redeploy, revert PR #482 or alter foreign work.

Preflight, break-glass evidence, controlled inputs, threshold observations, restart decision, restoration, timers, services, connector freshness and tool readback are immutable and exact-runtime-bound before T059 can become verified.
